author: Bryce Hoye
description: A new study published Thursday in the journal FACETS reveals severe declines in loon chick populations across North America over the past three decades or more.
title: The haunting call of Canada's common loon is becoming less common amid widespread declines, study suggests

description: Tennessee execution team members failed multiple times to establish working IV lines in Christa Pike's arms before her attempted execution and warned that some of her veins may have ruptured, or "blown," before she was injected with the lethal drug, her attorney wrote in a court document filed Thursday.
title: Execution staff warned of possibility some of Christa Pike's veins had 'blown': attorney

author: Abby Hughes
description: PHP is an open-source computer language that powers an estimated 70 per cent of the internet. While websites being taken offline caused alarm, that was done to implement a fix — which cybersecurity experts say show the system for remedying such issues is working.
title: What is PHP, and how did a flaw in its code lead several websites to go dark this week?

description: A magnitude 7 earthquake hit China's Tibet region on Thursday evening, killing at least 16 people, injuring 46 and collapsing hundreds of homes in the northern regional city of Nagqu, official media said.
title: Tibet earthquake kills at least 16

author: Hannah Spray
description: A Bangladeshi woman who was trafficked and exploited by two men in Saskatchewan — and repeatedly raped by one of them — says she now lives in fear and struggles to trust anyone.
title: 'They destroyed my life': 2 Sask. men imprisoned for exploiting woman from Bangladesh

description: New York City council passed a bill Thursday that would ban horse-drawn carriage rides by June 2028, pulling back the reins after the death of a teenage tourist last spring.
title: New York City council votes to advance bill that would ban horse-drawn carriages

author: Steve Rukavina
description: After emotional testimony from members of the Innu First Nation of Essipit in Quebec who’ve seen their lives upended, federal bureaucrats defended their decision to remove status from more than 700 Innu in the community.
title: Federal bureaucrats grilled over decision to strip status from over 700 Innu in Quebec

author: Mark Kennedy
description: Tom Skerritt, the Emmy-winning actor who embodied a solid, wry authority figure, whether as a flight instructor in Top Gun, a tough-but-fair sheriff on TV’s Picket Fences or the doomed captain of Alien, has died. He was 93.
title: Emmy-winning actor Tom Skerritt, with roles in Alien and Top Gun, dies at 93

author: Marina von Stackelberg
description: Canada's national mail carrier says it plans to start delivering parcels on the weekend to seven million households by the end of 2027, as part of the financially troubled Crown corporation's major restructuring.
title: Canada Post starting weekend parcel delivery in Toronto, Montreal and Ottawa this fall

author: Darren Major
description: The government of Canada has issued advice to all embassy and consulate staff to avoid appearing with U.S. midterm candidates, according to a source with knowledge of the notices.
title: Canadian diplomats based in U.S. advised to avoid appearing with midterm candidates

author: Jason Viau
description: Detroit’s tourism bureau has completely stopped marketing to Canada, saying they understand that the “antagonistic” American actions have strained relations between the two countries.
title: Detroit tourism bureau halts advertising in Canada amid trade war, hopes Canadians won't 'hold grudge'

description: Meta Platforms has struck a deal with Mark Zuckerberg, Reuters has reported, in a move spurred by a California ballot measure, part of the Nov. 3 midterm elections, that has sparked heated debate and hundreds of millions in campaign spending.
title: Meta board placates Zuckerberg after threat to leave California if voters approve wealth tax measure

author: Christine Pagulayan
description: Buckle up Heated Rivalry fans, we're heading back to the cottage — though this time, the date is actually at a movie theatre.
title: Heated Rivalry hitting theatres this November

description: U.S. prosecutors accuse L. Louise Lucas of running an illegal cannabis business with members of her family. The 82-year-old Virginia state senator said Thursday's actions amounted to the federal government wielding its "full weight" against a great-grandmother.
title: U.S. charges 82-year-old Virginia Democratic lawmaker in alleged drug scheme

author: Peter Zimonjic, Catharine Tunney
description: The Supreme Court of Canada will hear an appeal of a 2024 Federal Court ruling that found the government of former prime minister Justin Trudeau infringed the Charter rights of convoy participants when it invoked the Emergencies Act in 2022.
title: Top court will hear appeal on ruling that found feds violated Charter during convoy protest

description: The iron man streak for Montreal Canadiens captain Nick Suzuki is coming to an end. After 546 NHL games played, Suzuki will be sidelined for two to four weeks due to an upper-body injury, the team announced Thursday.
title: Habs captain's iron man streak ends, Nick Suzuki to miss 2 to 4 weeks due to injury

author: Jeff Lagerquist
description: Rogers Communications says a new 1.6 per cent “credit card processing charge” will apply starting Jan. 17.
title: Rogers to charge new fee for bills paid by credit card, says practice is ‘increasingly common’

description: Ottawa police say they've arrested and charged a 45-year-old man following an investigation into the alleged theft of thousands of mobile phones worth $7 million.
title: Man extorted sister in $7M phone theft from Bell, police say

author: Associated Press
description: The "looksmaxxing" livestreamer Braden Peters, better known by his stage name Clavicular, pleaded not guilty Thursday to charges that he raped a 17-year-old girl at his family's Massachusetts home. Peters is accused of giving the girl alcohol until she
title: 'Looksmaxxing' streamer Clavicular pleads not guilty to rape charge

author: Jillian Kestler-D'Amours
description: The European Parliament says this year's Sakharov Prize recognizes the International Criminal Court's "important work in upholding international law and justice." The tribunal in The Hague has faced escalating attacks from U.S. President Donald Trump's administration.
title: EU awards human rights prize to International Criminal Court amid Trump attacks

description: France on Thursday reported the first human case of the Shamonda virus usually found in livestock in a patient who later died, with authorities adding there was no risk to the general population at this stage.
title: 1st human case of livestock virus Shamonda reported in France

author: Chris Iorfida
description: Ron Duguay, who starred for his hometown Sudbury Wolves and became an immediate sensation on and off the ice with the New York Rangers, has died. He was 69.
title: Ron Duguay, hockey star who made impact on and off ice, dead at 69

description: In the last year, Canada's Molly Carlson has jumped from a moving helicopter into a cage surrounded by sharks, completed her highest dive yet from a 27-metre platform, and, in her latest nerve-defying feat, became the first woman to dive off an iceberg.
title: Canadian high diver welcomed fear during historic leap off Newfoundland iceberg

author: Myles Dichter
description: The federal government will announce supplemental funding for 60 national sports organizations on Thursday, sources told CBC Sports.
title: Federal government to announce new funding for 60 national sport organizations: sources

description: Seven oil tankers caught fire or were damaged in the Strait of Hormuz overnight after being hit by Iran or striking naval mines, Tehran said Thursday, a markedly high number as tensions rise over concerns about a return to all-out war.
title: Iran says 7 ships have been struck in Strait of Hormuz, Saudis intercept drones in airspace

author: Murray Brewster
description: Prime Minister Mark Carney's political and economic tightrope act began Thursday as he and Turkish President Recep Erdogan announced a strategic partnership aimed at expanding trade and defence co-operation.
title: Carney announces trade and defence partnership with Turkey

author: Murray Brewster
description: Prime Minister Mark Carney arrived in Turkey on Thursday for a historic visit aimed at strengthening trade and defence co-operation with the strategically important NATO ally. The trip underscores Ottawa’s efforts to diversify beyond the United States, while navigating sensitive questions about human rights and Ankara’s recent crackdown on civil society groups.
title: Carney walks a trade, defence and diplomatic tightrope in Turkey

description: Russia pounded Kyiv with ballistic missiles and Ukraine sent hundreds of drones towards Moscow overnight as the warring sides kept up a barrage of attacks despite the latest U.S. push to end ‌the conflict.
title: Russia pounds Ukraine's capital Kyiv with missiles and drones, hours after agreeing to peace talks

author: Jennifer Keiller
description: Two First Nations artists have pulled their work from the University of Calgary’s gallery in a protest over an event that invited students to debate whether residential schools were an act of genocide.
title: First Nations artists pull art from University of Calgary after event inviting debate on residential schools

description: How did a movement which began in French schools become an indictment of the French state itself? We have a look at what's behind France's largest protests in decades — and the role of widespread protest in French history and culture.
title: What's behind the youth protests in France?

description: After Forge and CF Montreal remained tied at one after regulation and extra time, the Hamilton-based side prevailed 4-2 in a shootout to become the first Canadian Premier League team to win the Canadian Championship.
title: Forge FC tops CF Montreal on penalty kicks to win Canadian championship

author: Sarah Smellie
description: EverWind, a company planning a massive data centre in Nova Scotia for artificial intelligence giant Anthropic, is in the midst of a dispute about land fees for a failed wind-powered hydrogen project in southern Newfoundland.
title: Firm behind planned Anthropic data centre in Nova Scotia denies owing fees to N.L.

author: Emily Chung
description: This week a UN summit aims to preserve the world's plants and animals. But a group of scientists wants to protect another diverse kingdom of species they say are too often forgotten – fungi. Here's a look at these beautiful organisms, why they aren't protected and why mycologists are fighting for 'justice' for them.
title: Biologists seek justice for forgotten kingdom of fungi

author: Leah Hendry
description: Ashton-Vitaly Evdosin, a 21-year-old student says he's had continuous problems with his certified pre-owned Volvo since he bought it last fall. None of the problems were flagged in the dealership's inspection report. He wants Volvo Canada to cancel the vehicle sale and refund his money.
title: He bought a used SUV from a Volvo dealer. He regrets trusting their inspection process

author: Christine Pagulayan
description: Writer Jack Thorne and director Marc Munden's four-part adaptation returns Lord of the Flies to its postwar British setting, giving the stranded boys richer backstories and exploring how their upbringing shapes the island’s descent into chaos.
title: Lord of the Flies reimagined for TV as a darker, more intimate take on the classic novel

author: Jackson Weaver
description: The Elizabeth Holmes documentary You Can See Everything, from Canadian comedian and director Nathan Fielder, is taking the world by storm. A grocery list of Canadian creatives are behind it.
title: Loved You Can See Everything? Thank Canada

author: Dave Seglins, Andreas Wesley, Saloni Bhugra
description: A new analysis for CBC News shows Canadians continue to be bombarded with betting promotions during sports broadcasts.
title: MPs moving to restrict gambling ads in Canada amid mounting harms

author: David Cummings
description: Young men and women tell CBC's The House that politics plays a big role in who they choose to date — as the political divide along gender lines become a major issue south of the border.
title: Politics is widening U.S. gender divides. In Canada? It's complicated

author: Olivia Stefanovich
description: More than 50 of Canada's leading scholars and scientists are urging Parliament to make major changes to a signature bill from Prime Minister Mark Carney’s government in an effort to avoid irreversible environmental harm for the s
title: Some of Canada's top scientists push for changes to Carney's new major projects bill

author: Jenna Legge
description: A chorus of boos awaited former Ottawa Senators captain Brady Tkachuk as he made his return to the ice at Canadian Tire Centre Wednesday night.
title: Boos, heckling greet Brady Tkachuk at 1st NHL game back in Ottawa
